SETTINGS_GENERAL_DESC: Manage basic site info and localization preferences.
SETTINGS_WORKSPACE_DESC: Manage the current workspace name and identifier.
SETTINGS_WORKSPACE_NAME_TOO_LONG: Workspace name is too long (max 128 characters)
SETTINGS_WORKSPACE_SLUG_TOO_LONG: Workspace slug is too long (max 64 characters)
SETTINGS_WORKSPACE_SLUG_INVALID: Workspace slug can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-), and cannot start or end with a hyphen
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_PANEL_DESC: Configure email delivery and what gets sent.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_ENABLED_DESC: When disabled, the system won't send any emails.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_CONFIG_HELP: Configure server, credentials, and security options.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_CONFIG_SHEET_DES: Before enabling email, make sure your deployment can reach the SMTP server (network, ports, certificates). Passwords are never shown: leaving it empty keeps the existing password. We recommend using a dedicated sender account with least privilege.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_PASSWORD_PLACEHO: Enter a new password to update
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_PASSWORD_SECRET_: A password is set and won't be shown. Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_TEMPLATES_DESC: Choose which system emails are sent.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_TEMPLATE_REG_PRO: Send a registration prompt when an invited member hasn't registered yet.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_TEMPLATE_WELCOME: Send a welcome email after a user signs up or an account is created.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_TEST_DESC: Send a test email to verify your SMTP configuration.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_MAIL_TEST_SUCCESS: Test email sent. If you don't see it, check spam and verify your SMTP settings.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_NOTIFICATION_PANEL_DE: Configure which in-app notifications are delivered.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_NOTIFICATION_SIDENAV_: Show the notification center preview in the sidebar. This only affects your account.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_NOTIFICATION_TYPES_DE: Choose which notifications appear in the notification center.
SETTINGS_MESSAGING_NOTIFICATION_INVITE_D: Receive notifications related to team invitations.
SETTINGS_SITE_NAME_DESC: Used for site branding and browser title.
SETTINGS_SITE_SUBTITLE_DESC: Used for portal title and footer display .
SETTINGS_SITE_DESCRIPTION_DESC: Used for SEO snippet and page description .
SETTINGS_SITE_URL_DESC: Used for generating links and emails.
SETTINGS_SITE_LOGO_DESC: Used for branding in admin and portal . Supports an http(s) URL or an absolute path starting with /.
SETTINGS_SITE_LOGO_PICKER_DESC: Pick or upload an image from the asset library for site branding.
SETTINGS_SITE_FAVICON_DESC: Used as the browser tab icon . Supports an http(s) URL or an absolute path starting with /.
SETTINGS_SITE_FAVICON_PICKER_DESC: Pick or upload a small and clear icon for the browser tab.
SETTINGS_SITE_AVATAR_PLACEHOLDER_DESC: Used when a user has no avatar. A square image is recommended.
SETTINGS_SITE_AVATAR_PLACEHOLDER_PICKER_: Pick or upload a default avatar placeholder from the asset library.
SETTINGS_SITE_CONTACT_EMAIL_DESC: Used for notifications, email signature, or contact info shown in the UI .
SETTINGS_LANGUAGE_DESC: Set your workspace language. This affects notifications and registration emails.
SETTINGS_TIMEZONE_DESC: Set your workspace timezone. This affects how timestamps are displayed.
SETTINGS_DATE_FORMAT_DESC: Set your workspace date format. This affects date display and exports.
SETTINGS_VALIDATION_URL_OR_PATH_INVALID: Enter a valid http(s) URL or a path starting with /
SETTINGS_LOAD_FAILED_DESC: Failed to load settings. Please check network and permissions, then retry.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PROVIDER_DESC: Choose where assets are stored. Switching only affects new uploads and usually requires a service restart and deployment config sync.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PROVIDER_DIALOG_DESC: Switch the storage backend (local / S3-compatible OSS).
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PROVIDER_DIALOG_HELP: Switching does not migrate existing assets automatically; it typically affects only new uploads. In production, update this during low-traffic hours and ensure deployment settings (env vars, credentials, network) are ready before restarting.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_DESC: CDN/domain base URL for public assets (e.g. https://cdn.example.com). Leave empty to use the API domain or fall back to presigned URLs.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_DIALOG_: Configure a public base URL (recommended: CDN domain).

This affects how public URLs are generated for SEO and sharing. We recommend using a stable, internet-accessible CDN domain such as https://static.example.com. If left empty, the system falls back to generating URLs based on the current request host.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_UPLOAD_POLICY_DESC: Configure upload size limits. Chunk size is under Advanced settings.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_UPLOAD_POLICY_SHEET_DES: Upload limits and chunk strategy that affect resumable upload and large file UX.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_UPLOAD_POLICY_SHEET_HEL: The max file size limits how large any single upload can be. Chunk size is an advanced option that affects request count and retry granularity: larger chunks mean fewer requests but higher cost on retry; smaller chunks provide more flexible retries but more requests. Choose based on network conditions and file types (especially video).
SETTINGS_STORAGE_UPLOAD_POLICY_ADVANCED_: Only adjust chunk size when optimizing large uploads or retries on unreliable networks.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_S3_CONFIG_DESC: Only applies when the provider is S3-compatible OSS. Secret fields are not shown; leave empty to keep unchanged.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_S3_CONFIG_SHEET_HELP: Secret fields are never displayed: leaving them empty keeps the existing secret unchanged. Prefer least-privilege access keys and make sure bucket policy/CORS settings support your public access and upload requirements.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PANEL_GLOBAL_DESC: Global policies for uploads and public delivery.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PANEL_LOCAL_DESC: Local paths are deployment-level settings. This panel provides guidance and checks.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_PANEL_S3_DESC: Configure an S3-compatible OSS (e.g. MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / gateways).
SETTINGS_STORAGE_LOCAL_INFO_DESC: Local paths are deployment-level settings; manage them via environment variables.
SETTINGS_STORAGE_LOCAL_INFO_DIALOG_DESC: Local paths are deployment-level settings (not stored in the database).
SETTINGS_STORAGE_LOCAL_INFO_DRAWER_DESC: Local storage paths are deployment-level settings. Defaults to data/uploads (tmp: data/uploads/.tmp). To change them, set STORAGE__LOCAL_ROOT_DIR and STORAGE__LOCAL_TMP_DIR in your deployment environment and restart the service.
